description: Event bus middleware pipeline fails to propagate event transformations across sequential middleware handlers, causing downstream subscribers to receive un-sanitized events.
spec_notes: Invariant: Each middleware in the pipeline must receive the transformed output of the preceding middleware.

repo_files.event.py:
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, Any, List

@dataclass
class Event:
    name: str
    payload: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

tests.test_bus.py:
from event import Event
from middleware import sanitize_middleware, tagging_middleware
from bus import EventBus

def test_direct_publish_no_middleware():
    bus = EventBus()
    received = []
    bus.subscribe("user_login", lambda e: received.append(e))
    bus.publish(Event("user_login", {"user": "alice"}))
    assert len(received) == 1
    assert received[0].payload == {"user": "alice"}

def test_middleware_pipeline_propagation():
    bus = EventBus()
    bus.use(sanitize_middleware)
    bus.use(tagging_middleware)
    
    received = []
    bus.subscribe("user_signup", lambda e: received.append(e))
    
    evt = Event("user_signup", {"user": "bob", "password": "secret123"})
    bus.publish(evt)
    
    assert len(received) == 1
    res = received[0]
    assert "password" not in res.payload
    assert "processed" in res.tags
